checks.claim: The suite passes on the change as submitted.
The number of tests the change claims to add matches the number the suite gained.
Every deliberate shortcut carries a summon: marker; none is stale.
No dependency in the change carries a known vulnerability.
Over the last ten real reviews (the planted fixture excluded), the lenses did not return unanimous verdicts every time; fewer than ten is a sample, not a signal.
On the planted-defect fixture, every lens returns at least one finding in its latest round.
The instance reviewing an item is not the instance that coded it.
Stylesheets in the change meet the contrast floor and respect reduced motion.
